patch.value: Tracker-only PM governance commits cannot satisfy required CI without changing the generated changelog

The required static CI lane runs changelog:pm:check against every push. A deliberately tracker-only audit that closes PM items changes the generated changelog input, so exact-head CI fails unless the session also edits CHANGELOG.md, contradicting a valid PM-only/no-docs scope and making direct tracker governance unable to produce a green required-check set.

Decide and document whether tracker-only closed-item mutations must always regenerate CHANGELOG.md or may be classified outside product changelog inputs; CI, contributor guidance, pm-changelog generation, and auto-release change classification share one explicit contract; a clean fixture proves a tracker-only planning commit can follow that contract without an empty npm/Bun release; a negative control proves a product-visible closed item still fails when its generated changelog is stale; direct-main and PR paths report the same policy; regression evidence references an exact source SHA and generated artifact diff; no manual CHANGELOG edits are introduced

Commit only append-only .agents/pm planning and evidence changes that close a PM item; push to main; observe CI run 30897051387 job 91952524714 fail in Run static + secret + version gates because pnpm changelog:pm:check reports CHANGELOG.md out of date.

A tracker-only PM governance commit has an explicit policy path that preserves generated changelog ownership and still yields an honest required-check result without requiring an out-of-scope docs mutation or empty product release.

The tracker-only audit commit reached main, but the required CI static job failed solely because CHANGELOG.md was intentionally not regenerated; all preceding version and extension setup steps succeeded.
